name: Horizontal lanes (wheat / flowers)
description: Two stacked layers of 96-block lanes: two crop rows on each side of a walking path, with a water channel every 6 blocks. SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: At the end, step one path over (+Z by 6)
Repeat; drop to the lower layer when the top layer is done
harvest_direction: Along X, breaking the two rows on each side of the path
water_notes: Water channels at z = 0, 6, 12, ... keep every farmland block within 4 blocks of water (vanilla hydration rule).
build_order: Place the glass ceiling of the lower layer before the upper layer's farmland so water cannot flow down.
